-- Contacts
SELECT
    source.ContactOrUserId AS SourceId,
    target_users.Id AS TargetId
FROM
    source
INNER JOIN target_users
    ON source.ContactOrUserId = target_users.ContactLegacyId__c

UNION

-- Users
SELECT
    source.ContactOrUserId AS SourceId,
    target_users.Id AS TargetId
FROM
    source
INNER JOIN target_users
    ON source.ContactOrUserId = target_users.Legacy_ID__c
